$doc: ADR 0630 layer 1 — the BACKLOG of `features/<id>` imports outside the registry, one entry per (file, feature).
Read by scripts/check-feature-import-boundary.mjs. It is SHRINK-ONLY and EXACT: an entry that matches no import fails the gate
(remove it when the import is fixed), and a new import not entered here fails the gate. Every entry carries `owner` and `why`
so it is a reviewable deferral, not a bypass. `owner` is the ADR 0001 feature package that owns the leaked module — this repo
has no CODEOWNERS, so the package IS the owner. `feature` is the registry id (or the bare `features/<dir>` for a dir with no id).
MEASURED 2026-09-04 on 2c6604f12: 42 imports, 23 pairs. How each one is fixed depends on its verdict — `excludable`: route the
public page/route matcher through the registry (a `publicRoutes` seam) so exclusion removes it; `frontend-unregistered`: give
the feature a FrontendFeature entry so the filter has something to remove; `unregistered`: give it a registry id first.
